description: Creates a copy-only retained packet with hashes, provenance, successor mapping, and restore evidence. Use when a user asks to prepare or qualify an archive without deleting files, removing discovery, or changing live lifecycle state.
intent_owner: Copy-only archive packet creation and restore qualification
intent: Create one immutable proposed archive packet for a bounded source tree.
outcome: Produce complete file hashes, provenance, successor mapping, and a successful isolated restore verification.
non_goals: Remove a live skill from discovery
Cut over or install a successor

permissions.allowed_scope: Declared archive proposal and isolated restore-test roots only

positive: test restoring a retained skill snapshot
map an archived skill to successors without deleting it

lifecycle.promotion_gate: Hash-complete packets, isolated restore tests, retention policy, and owner approval

instructions: Require a qualifying stable fingerprint before copying and stop if the source changes.
Copy every source file as inert payload without executing scripts or loading it as instructions.
Record relative path, byte length, SHA-256, provenance, source state, successor mapping, and the explicit label copy-only-not-archived.
Restore the payload into an isolated proposal directory and compare the complete manifest byte for byte.
Report missing, extra, or changed files as failure and retain the failed evidence.
Return separate later commands and approvals for live snapshot, removal from discovery, lifecycle transition, compatibility alias, cutover, or deletion; execute none of them.
